resources.string: A SandFly Pro code can renew by card every month or year. Go to Settings, SandFly Pro, and choose Turn on automatic renewal. The SandFly Pro screen then shows the renewal date. To cancel automatic renewal or change the card, choose Manage subscription on the same screen. SandFly posts a notification before a renewal or an end date, and when a payment fails.

SandFly takes a picture with the camera and describes it, and you can ask follow-up questions about the picture. To use it, assign Take picture and describe in Settings, Commands, Image and screen descriptions.
Live recognition has a Light level mode, which says how much light the light sensor measures, such as Dim light or Bright light.

Whisper and the on-device model can stay in memory for 5, 15 or 30 minutes after use, so that the next recognition starts faster. Go to Settings, Typing, Dictation, or Settings, Image and screen descriptions, and choose Keep recognition models loaded.

SandFly can show the recent apps as a list, in place of the system overview. Go to Settings, Overview, and turn on Use SandFly\'s overview. It needs Shizuku. The Overview command, the navigation gesture and the Recents button open the list. Double-tap an app to switch to it. The actions of an app are Close, Split screen and App info. To put the most recent app last, turn on Most recent app at the bottom. To show the apps as a grid, choose Columns.

With Use SandFly\'s overview on, hold Alt and press Tab on a physical keyboard to move through the recent apps. SandFly says each app. Release Alt to switch to the app, or press Escape to stay in the current app.

The Previous app command switches to the app used before the app on screen. Using the Overview command again while SandFly overview is open does the same. The command is in Settings, Commands, System actions.
System overview opens the system overview, also with Use SandFly\'s overview on. Take screenshot takes a screenshot. Both commands are in Settings, Commands, System actions.

The Split screen menu goes to the divider and runs the actions of the divider. Choose Split screen in the SandFly menu, or assign the Split screen command in Settings, Commands, System actions. To open an app in split screen, choose Open in split screen in the actions of an app icon on the home screen, swipe up with three fingers in the braille app launcher, or swipe down with three fingers in the handwriting app launcher. It needs Shizuku.

Every element command and browse mode key now works in apps as well as on web pages, including buttons, checkboxes, lists, tables, landmarks and headings of each level. SandFly scrolls to reach the next element. Apps do not report heading levels or visited links, so each heading level moves through all headings, and all links in an app count as unvisited.

The Sentences reading control moves through text one sentence at a time. Swipe down for the next sentence and up for the previous sentence. To add the reading control, go to Settings, Reading controls.

You can make named lists of reading controls, each with Next and Previous commands. Go to Settings, Reading controls, Reading control lists, and choose Add list. The commands are in Settings, Commands, Reading control lists.
The Editing menu has Clipboard history, Copy, Add to clipboard, Cut, Paste, Select all and selection mode. To use the menu, assign Editing menu in Settings, Commands, Text editing.

The Symbol dictionary replaces a symbol or a sequence of symbols wherever the exact text appears, in speech and on a braille display. Go to Settings, Speech, Symbol dictionary, or Settings, Braille, Symbol dictionary, and choose Add a replacement.

Volume change feedback replaces Speak volume changes. Go to Settings, Volume keys, Volume change feedback, and choose Off, Tone, Speech, or Tone and speech. Speech says the volume and the level, such as Media volume set to 60 percent, also while media plays.

To set how long a volume key is held to run a long press command, go to Settings, Volume keys, Volume key long press duration. Volume key commands also run on an always-on display that shows the lock screen.
Speak item type without a pause
To say the name and the type of an item with no pause between them, go to Settings, Verbosity, and turn on Speak item type without a pause.

SandFly plays a sound when an on-screen keyboard opens or closes, for all on-screen keyboards. To change whether SandFly announces that the keyboard is shown or hidden, go to Settings, Verbosity, Announce keyboard shown or hidden.
